renderer.adaptation: Same pixel and layout operations; public evidence paths, explicit font and expected-hash verification replace private input paths.

display.clipping: Display only; values outside [0,1] are clipped. Dynamics fields were not clipped.
display.interior: All 4748 prebound cells in the fixed 80x80 readout bounding box; uint8 display codes; gray outside the readout; no recentering.
display.context: 128x128 arrays of 4x4 block means, quantized to four bits per field; a wider, coarser view, not an independent endpoint.
display.orientation: Origin at lower left, matching the accepted static evidence.
display.time: 101 observations at relative time0..250 in increments2.5. Source-clock labels250..500 use a new paired-noise branch, not continuation of the historical random stream.

video_frame_policy: 101 saved observations shown once each at5fps; each held0.2seconds;20.2seconds total; no interpolated scientific motion.
reproduction_scope: Saved quantized evidence and exact presentation. Original full-field checkpoint and all native execution dependencies are hash-identified but not all bundled here.

overview.method: Fixed PNG crops at t=0,200,250 for all six cases; nearest-neighbor resizing; no new field calculation.

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.0.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers

scientific_assessment.report_transformation: None; both Markdown reports, the concise report and scientific JSON records preserve exact sealed bytes.
scientific_assessment.reader_takeaway: Persistent visible organization survived in controls, but the specified original feature did not return after interior erasure in the two interpretable recovery cases.
scientific_assessment.entry_point: research/README.md summarizes the sealed finding and links the full reports; it is not another scientific review.

configuration_publication_note: The public configuration omits one absolute controller path. Its original frozen identity remains in source_transfers and the execution records; the public-copy hash is distinct. No scientific parameter changes.
